d: The Associate Director, People Capability (UAE National) serves as a pivotal leader within Standard Chartered's creative and delivery teams, providing expert guidance, mentorship, and hands-on support to a talented group of practitioners primarily located in regional hubs. This role involves nurturing professional growth and maximizing the impact of individuals within agile squads, ensuring alignment with the bank's broader learning and development goals.

Key responsibilities include integrating contemporary storytelling and immersive experiences into design practices to enrich the visual and educational quality of the bank's learning offerings. The roleholder champions the continuous enhancement of standards, methodologies, and operational processes within the discipline, fostering innovation and excellence.

The Associate Director holds a significant role in supporting regulatory learning initiatives related to Emiratisation in the UAE, working closely with regulatory bodies, educational institutions, and internal stakeholders to ensure compliance, readiness for audits, and alignment with government requirements.

Through collaborative partnership with Hub Leads and Tribal Heads, they play an instrumental role in ensuring that learning programs meet both local regulatory expectations and global standards, driving consistency and quality across teams and geographies.
q: Proven expertise in learning design and development principles, with a strong track record of delivering impactful educational interventions.
Experience managing agile projects and driving iterative development cycles within dynamic environments.
Proficiency in design prototyping and experimental techniques to rapidly validate and refine learning solutions.
Data literacy skills enabling insightful analysis and measurement of learning program effectiveness.
Horizon scanning capabilities to anticipate emerging trends and technologies in the learning and development space.
Solid business acumen with the ability to align learning initiatives with strategic objectives and operational realities.
Familiarity with contemporary learning platforms including on-demand, social, experiential, and virtual/interactive modalities.
Demonstrated ability to foster innovation and adaptability within diverse teams and complex project settings.
Strong command of English, both written and spoken, is mandatory to operate effectively in a multinational setting.
Proficiency in Arabic is highly desirable and considered an advantage to effectively engage with local stakeholders and regulatory bodies within the UAE.

d: The Head of Transaction Banking is responsible for leading and developing Bank of Jordan’s Transaction Banking business across the Group’s markets.

The role has end-to-end responsibility for Transaction Banking activities, including Sales & Relationship Management, Product Development and Management, Client Implementation, Digital Transaction Banking Solutions, and Client Services.

The role is responsible for defining and executing the Group’s Transaction Banking strategy, driving sustainable revenue growth, developing innovative and digitally enabled solutions, expanding market penetration, and ensuring a consistent and client-centric service proposition across the Bank’s markets.

The position oversees Transaction Banking solutions including Cash Management, Trade Finance, Liquidity Management, Digital Channels, APIs and other corporate banking solutions, while ensuring alignment with the Bank’s strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, risk appetite, and operational standards.
q: Develop and maintain a high-quality Transaction Banking client servicing model across the Bank’s markets.
Define and monitor service standards, turnaround times, service-level indicators, and issue-resolution mechanisms.
Ensure client inquiries and service issues are addressed effectively and within agreed service levels.
Utilize client feedback, service data, and operational insights to continuously enhance products, processes, and service delivery.
Promote a consistent and differentiated client experience across Transaction Banking channels and markets.
Ensure Transaction Banking products, services, and activities comply with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and the Bank’s risk management framework.
Work closely with Risk, Compliance, AML, Legal, Operations, Information Security, and other control functions to identify and mitigate risks associated with Transaction Banking activities.
Ensure appropriate product governance, approvals, controls, documentation, and monitoring mechanisms are maintained.
Monitor operational, regulatory, financial crime, technology, and product-related risks and ensure appropriate corrective actions are implemented.
Maintain strong governance and oversight of Transaction Banking activities across the Group’s markets.
Own and manage the Transaction Banking business performance, including revenues, profitability, transaction volumes, product penetration, and client utilization.
Develop annual business plans, budgets, forecasts, and performance targets.
Monitor product and client profitability and identify opportunities to improve revenue contribution and operating efficiency.
Provide regular management reporting and business insights to senior management on Transaction Banking performance, opportunities, challenges, and market developments.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Transaction Banking team with appropriate functional and market capabilities.
Establish clear objectives, performance expectations, and accountability across the function.
Promote collaboration between Transaction Banking teams, relationship managers, product teams, operations, technology, and support functions.
Identify and develop critical Transaction Banking capabilities and future leadership talent.
Encourage a culture of innovation, ownership, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and client focus.
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Banking, Economics, or a related discipline.
MBA, Master’s degree, or relevant professional qualification is preferred.
Minimum 15 years of progressive banking experience.
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience within Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Trade Finance, Payments, Liquidity Solutions, Corporate Banking, or related areas.
At least 5 years of experience in a senior leadership or executive-level role.
Demonstrated experience in leading Transaction Banking businesses, products, or functions within a major financial institution.
Proven experience in developing and commercializing Transaction Banking products and solutions.
Strong exposure to digital transformation, digital transaction banking platforms, APIs, host-to-host connectivity, and technology-enabled banking solutions.
Experience managing businesses or functions across multiple markets or jurisdictions is highly preferred.
Demonstrated track record of driving revenue growth, client acquisition, product penetration, and business profitability.
Strong knowledge of Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Trade Finance, Payments, Liquidity Management and Digital Banking solutions.
Strong commercial orientation with demonstrated ability to grow revenues and develop profitable client propositions.
Strong product development and innovation capabilities.
Strong understanding of digital Transaction Banking and emerging banking technologies.
Strategic thinking and ability to translate strategy into executable business plans.
r: Develop and lead the Group Transaction Banking strategy in alignment with the Bank’s overall strategic objectives and Corporate Banking priorities.
Drive the growth and expansion of Transaction Banking capabilities across the Bank’s markets, ensuring scalability, consistency, and commercial viability.
Identify emerging market trends, client needs, technology developments, and new business opportunities to strengthen the Bank’s competitive positioning.
Benchmark the Bank’s Transaction Banking proposition against leading regional and international practices and identify opportunities for continuous enhancement.
Establish and monitor business plans, revenue targets, profitability objectives, and key performance indicators for Transaction Banking.
Lead Transaction Banking sales activities across key client segments, including Large Corporates, SMEs, Financial Institutions, Government and Public Sector entities.
Drive client acquisition, cross-selling, wallet-share growth, and transaction banking penetration within the Bank’s existing and prospective client base.
Partner closely with Corporate Banking, Institutional Banking, Treasury, and other relevant business units to identify and originate Transaction Banking opportunities.
Develop tailored client solutions covering cash management, trade finance, liquidity, payments, collections, and digital transaction banking.
Promote a strong culture of commercial performance, accountability, collaboration, and client centricity.
Lead the development, enhancement, and lifecycle management of the Bank’s Transaction Banking products and solutions.
Ensure the Bank’s product offering remains competitive, commercially viable, compliant, and responsive to evolving client requirements.
Drive the development of solutions across Cash Management, Payments, Collections, Trade Finance, Liquidity Management, Digital Channels and other specialized Transaction Banking services.
Identify opportunities to introduce new products, enhance existing propositions, and improve product profitability and utilization.
Work closely with Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, Finance, and other stakeholders throughout the product development and approval process.
Lead the digital transformation agenda for Transaction Banking and enhance the Bank’s digital proposition for corporate and institutional clients.
Drive the development and enhancement of digital Transaction Banking platforms, including online banking, mobile solutions, APIs, host-to-host connectivity and system integrations.
Identify opportunities to automate processes, improve straight-through processing, and enhance the efficiency and scalability of Transaction Banking services.
Leverage technology and market developments to introduce innovative solutions that improve the client experience and strengthen the Bank’s competitive positioning.
Partner with Technology and Digital Banking teams to ensure Transaction Banking platforms are secure, resilient, scalable, and responsive to business requirements.
Establish and oversee an effective Client Implementation function to ensure smooth and timely onboarding of Transaction Banking solutions.
Ensure effective coordination between clients and internal stakeholders throughout implementation and integration activities.
Establish clear implementation governance, project milestones, escalation mechanisms, and service standards.
Oversee complex client integrations, including APIs, host-to-host connectivity and customized transaction banking arrangements.
Identify opportunities to shorten implementation timelines and improve the overall onboarding experience.

d: Bank ABC seeks to recruit a Senior Credit Underwriter in the Head Office Credit Department based in our Head Office in Bahrain.
q: Minimum of a Bachelors degree. A postgraduate MSc/MBA degree &/or professional qualification is a plus/preferred and an added advantage
At least 10 years preferably with an international bank demonstrating some mobility
Knowledge of accounting principles, financial statement analysis, banking products and services with strong credit analytical skills.
Good knowledge of vanilla credit product risks and key aspects of legal documentation.
Good knowledge of corporate and bank balance sheet analysis techniques
Good understanding and familiarity of the Bank/Corporate and FI market, credit products.
An understanding of the Bank’s lending policies, procedures, and practices.
Should possess good analytical skills and awareness of various financial products / services.
Should have good analytical skills to analyze Banking Industry and analyze individual bank’s capital, asset quality, profitability, and liquidity.

r: Reporting to the Group Chief Credit Officer, the job holder will be responsible for:
Supporting, promoting, monitoring, and controlling, on an independent and ongoing basis, the Bank’s pursuit of good quality loan and other risk assets within the Corporate Credit portfolio.

Evaluating the credit risk of new business and the periodic risk review of existing clients and ensuring these are aligned with risk appetite, policies, and procedures. Responsible for making a clear and timely recommendation to the appropriate credit committee with key risks clearly highlighted along with mitigation available.
Timely submission of credit proposals in line with prescribed timeframe for GCC submission Establish clear procedures for the underwriting process
Ensuring that any documentation outstanding on the OOO (Out of Order) report is covered in the CAF and reasons provided to mitigate any potential risk.
Monitoring developments in the countries he/she covers. There is an expectation of travel to the countries if the GHCCU required job holder to do so to undertake portfolio reviews.
Ensuring adherence to Group’s Risk Appetite Statement, Group Credit Policy, Standards, and related procedures.
Providing support in terms of interpretation of the Group Credit Policy its related Standards and Procedures.

Conducting regular portfolio reviews of various corporate obligors, understand, review, interpret and adopt all Credit policies and procedures. Escalate key risk issues related to the credit portfolio constituents.
From time to time the job holder will be required to deliver reports on sectors within a country or assist in the compilation of a wider report across many jurisdictions.
Providing assistance and support as part of the general day to day business and on CRG’s transformational projects.

Ensuring that they are receiving appropriate training from either internal or external sources. The CCU must attend at least one course per annum from an external provider and take regular internal seminars or presentations from subject matter experts.
